<function name="GetNetworked2Angle" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Retrieves a networked angle value at specified index on the entity that is set by <page>Entity:SetNetworked2Angle</page>.
<deprecated>You should be using <page>Entity:GetNW2Angle</page> instead.</deprecated></description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="key" type="string">The key that is associated with the value</arg>
		<arg name="fallback" type="any" default="Angle( 0, 0, 0 )">The value to return if we failed to retrieve the value. (If it isn't set)</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="any">The value associated with the key</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
